dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: I thought I heard someone nearby, and for a second I feared it might be a monster...

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: Hmm? Patrolling means keeping an eye out for monsters. Honestly, Oskari... you still get startled way too easily.

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: I've mentioned this before. No matter how bad things look, keep your composure. If an enemy notices you're shaken, it'll only make things harder.

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: But... you also said that we can intentionally look weak when things aren't in our favor to get the enemy's guard down, giving us a chance to hit back.

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: ...Ow, my wound flared up again just now.

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: What!? Master, didn't you get better already? Why is it suddenly...
